Another machine on your network cannot open it. It has no login of its own, because nothing outside your computer can reach it. Two guards carry that weight, described below. Your keys live in one settings file inside the desk folder. The update never touches it, the backup never includes it, and the page your AI reads tells the AI not to read it.
